title: No two members with the same email
prompt: Members are getting registered twice with the same email address, sometimes in a different case (Ann@Example.org and ann@example.org). Make sure there can never be two members with the same email. Trying to add a duplicate should raise an error.
notes: A UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE constraint is one line and covers every path into the table. The lazy-wrong version checks inside add_member only; the bulk import still duplicates.
extension: Add `find_member(conn, email)` that returns the member's name for an email, ignoring case, or None.
